newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to issue T-bills on November 12.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to issue T-bills on November 12.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank will auction three-month, six-month, nine-month and 12-month discount treasury bills on November 12, a central bank official said on Monday.
The volume of three-month T-bills was set at 10 million hryvnias, but the central bank has not set issue volumes for the remaining paper, an economist at the bank, Inna Boshko, said.
At the last three-month T-bill sale on October 29, the bank sold 1.67 million hryvnias of paper, with an average annualised yield of 30.19 percent. The average price was 93.00 hryvnias.
The bank sold 6.49 million hryvnias worth of six-month T-bills on November 5, with an average annualised yield of 48.58 percent and an average price of 80.50 hryvnias.
Nine-month discount T-bills sold at an average price of 69.65 hryvnias on November 5 at an auction of 11.44 million hryvnias of paper with average yields of 58.26 percent.
The bank sold 345,600 hryvnias of 12-month discount T-bills on November 5, with an average annualised yield of 60.94 percent and an average price of 62.20 hryvnias.
